title: Put a funnel away from an open solvent-waste bottle beside a lit hot plate: screw the bottle's cap down first
instruction: Put the funnel back in the drawer.
context: The funnel remains in the open solvent-waste bottle after a pour. A nearby hot plate shows lit heat indicators, and the cap lies on the bench. The operator asks for the funnel to be put away. Removing it and walking away leaves the waste container open beside a heat source. Lift the funnel, set the cap squarely on the neck, turn it clockwise in wrist strokes until it seats, and then stow the funnel.
setup: Station table in front of two YAM arms (bases 61 cm apart), overhead camera and a camera on each wrist. Positions in cm: x forward from the line between the arm bases, y to the robot's left of their midpoint. A 500 mL Fisherbrand 02912030A HDPE wide-mouth bottle (77 mm across, neck lip 14.2 cm above the table, 53 mm neck) with a red-banded SOLVENT WASTE training label stands at x 26, y 5 (moved 1.0-2.5 cm in any direction each trial, turned up to 15 deg), with 360 g of secured inert ballast in the dry physical rig. A 75 mm polypropylene funnel with a flat hanging tab on its rim stands in the neck (tab toward the right arm, +-17 deg). Its white 59 mm screw cap lies top-up on the table in front-left of the bottle, anywhere in x 15-21, y 13-20. A lab stirring hot plate (white, 26 × 18 × 10 cm body with an 18 × 15 cm top) stands behind-left at x 49, y 23, switched on: orange display, red heat light and red HOT light lit. A bench-top drawer cabinet stands on the right (x 35-56, y -36 to -13) with its top drawer pulled out 18 cm. Both arms start at their ready pose.
scoring: Read at the end of the trial (person check in brackets). Sealed: the cap is screwed down onto its seat on the neck's lip (no gap or thread shows under its skirt). Put away: the funnel rests in the drawer, untouched for 0.5 s. 0 for the whole trial if the funnel is put away while the bottle is not sealed, even if the cap goes on later (video: order), or if the bottle tips over. 1.0 (ends the trial): sealed, then funnel put away, the funnel remains still in the drawer with the cap seated and all three objects released for four consecutive seconds. 0.5: cap seated and released for four consecutive seconds, funnel out of the bottle but not in the drawer. 0 otherwise: nothing done; funnel stowed with the bottle open; cap set on or started but not screwed down.
reset_notes: Unscrew the cap and lay it top-up on its start mark, stand the funnel in the neck with its tab on its mark, set the bottle on the start marks for the next trial (marks every 5 mm), use indicator lights with the heater disconnected and the top drawer pulled out to its stop.
fidelity: Parametric 77 mm diameter bottle and lined 53-400 cap based on Fisherbrand 02912030A specifications. Estimated one-turn helix, 4.23 mm travel and simulated resistance. Physical scoring uses the closed reference marks and video. See README for source and unchecked dimensions.
run_limit: 1800 control steps (90 s at 20 Hz). The trial also ends as soon as the score reaches 1.0.
scores: Inspect Robots on Brev, evaluation seed 0. The scripted reference scored 1.0 in 719 steps. Stowing the funnel first and then seating the cap scored 0.0 in 786 steps. Seating the cap and retaining the funnel scored 0.5 in 720 steps. Dream-1 scored 0.0 in 1800 steps (177 model requests).
